subject: Error during conversion from MaxQuant to MSStat format

messages.author: 4d355e2701591d7c
messages.subject: Error during conversion from MaxQuant to MSStat format
parts:
Hi, 

I was just looking into your package and I was trying to analyse a set of LFQ data. But when converting my data into a MSStat format it gives me this error. I searched but I have not found anything similar. 

What am I doing wrong? 


INFO  [2022-02-22 19:20:21] ** Raw data from MaxQuant imported successfully.
INFO  [2022-02-22 19:20:21] ** + Contaminant, + Reverse, + Potential.contaminant, + Only.identified.by.site proteins are removed.
Error in merge.data.table(mq_input, unique(mq_pg[, list(uniquefromProteinGroups = ProteinIDs,  :
  Elements listed in `by` must be valid column names in x and y
In addition: Warning message:
In merge.data.table(mq_input, unique(mq_pg[, list(uniquefromProteinGroups = ProteinIDs,  :
  You are trying to join data.tables where 'y' argument is 0 columns data.table.

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Error during conversion from MaxQuant to MSStat format
parts:
Hi,


just looking at that error message: is there a ProteinIDs in your protein groups file?


Kind regards,
Mateusz
